topics.hook_summary: A freaking Inu with zero centralized exchanges went to $3B in 2021 (live holy-crap chart reveal); therefore a Robinhood-chain token that gets listed in the Robinhood app in a parabolic bull run could do 10-20B, and we're the early ones. Became clips 1+6.

July paradox: least layoffs in two years but nonfarm payrolls printed NEGATIVE vs +80K expected; retail jobs are what pump crypto; the four-year cycle zombies expect an October bottom and we might be right on time for things to go wrong, but there's not going to be ANY October bottom: like they turned September green last year, they'll buy in and turn October green. Became clips 2+7.

High price predictions sound unrealistic, but he put a 20x on the LAB token, bought the December bottom, and it did a 350x; Velvet got a 30x call and did a 58x with room to grow: when he misses, he misses to the downside. Became clip 3.

Tendies floats his boat BECAUSE it's funny and stupid (fart-coin logic): exactly the type of meme Vlad will want to list on the Robinhood app; from 16M now to over a billion if listed in a bull run, imagine 10B, nothing's financial advice. Became clip 4.

Eventually people buy crypto, meme coins, the alts, come onto the Robinhood chain and learn to swap; the economic expansion is real but not felt yet, the bull run starts over, and a lot of you are going to be lucky you just tried to endure the pain. Became clip 5.
